name: sengify
description: LLM-wiki feature planning: ingest docs into a persistent project wiki, grill features into use cases, and taskify them into a plan ready for scalpel

interface.shortDescription: LLM-wiki feature planning for AI-assisted development
interface.longDescription: sengify builds a persistent, queryable project wiki from your product docs, then grills feature ideas into concrete use cases and a high-level task plan — ready to hand to scalpel for file-level implementation planning.
defaultPrompt: I want to ingest a design doc into the project wiki.
Help me grill this feature idea into use cases.
